stepBody: Suppose we choose $$\hat{\theta}=(2,1)**{T}.$$ Consider the wine 'Billywine' with hue $$\frac{1}{4}$$ and abv $$-2.$$\nLet $$\gamma$$ be the probability that Billywine is a type $$1$$ wine under our model. What is $$\gamma?$$ Select all that apply. $$(\beta$$ is as defined in the previous subpart.)
